name: Carbonmark REST API
description: Welcome to the API Reference docs for **version v18** of the Carbonmark REST API. Use this API to view assets, prices, supply, activity and more. To find the latest stable version, visit [docs.carbonmark.com](https://docs.carbonmark.com). ## Quick start Be sure to prefix a version number, otherwise your application will be exposed to breaking changes. ~~~ts const res = await fetch("https://v18.api.carbonmark.com/projects"); const projects = await res.json(); ~~~ For a developer guides and example implementations, or to learn more about Carbonmark and the Carbon Market, view our product knowledge base at docs.carbonmark.com. ##
